title: Approach for trucks
html:
With the rules regarding traffic and access for constructing and dismantling stands we want to help you and your stand construction companies to have as trouble-free a time on the Koelnmesse grounds as possible.

Closure of the Zoobrücke bridge for heavy-duty vehicles over 30 tons

Please note that Cologne’s Zoobrücke bridge has been closed to heavy-duty vehicles over 30 tons gross vehicle weight since 15th October 2010. Heavy-duty vehicles over 30 tons are beeing diverted via the motorway ring. Please use the detour routes that have been posted by the city of Cologne.

Alternate route recommendation of the city of Cologne (.pdf)

Your way to central fair parking P22 (.pdf)

Closure of the Mülheimer Brücke bridge for heavy-duty vehicles over 3.5 tons

Please note that Cologne’s Mülheimer Brücke bridge has been closed to heavy-duty vehicles over 3.5 tons gross vehicle weight since 15 April 2019. You can find more information with corresponding maps on the website of the city of Cologne.

Low Emission Zone

Most of Cologne’s metrolpolitan area is a low emission zone. Vehicles entering this zone must carry a green sticker (emission group 4).

Low emission zone map (.pdf)

Environmental badges

Trade fair visitors from Germany and abroad with appropriately equipped vehicles can obtain the stickers for access to the Low Emission Zone from www.environmental-badge.co.uk
